v2.0   •   Issued  by  the  Office  of  the  MD  
Six  steps  to  a  good  consultation.  Read  once.  Use  every  day.  No  theory  —  just  the  next  move.  
HOW  A  CONSULTATION  SHOULD  FEEL  You  diagnose,  you  do  not  sell.  You  build  rapport  before  you  build  authority.  You  let  her  talk  before  you  talk.  You  quote  per  package,  never  just  the  total.  You  handle  objections  —  you  never  justify.  You  never  disclose  the  after-discount  amount  without  her  yes.  You  always  end  with  a  clear  next  step  —  visit,  payment,  or  follow-up  date.  
The  Six  Steps  
Six  steps.  In  order.  Same  flow  for  every  consultation,  every  walk-in,  every  revisit.  
1  
RAPPORT  Open  the  door.  Smile.  Greet  by  name.  Seat  her.  Tea  /  coffee  /  water.  Gather  her  context  —  profession,  location,  medical  history,  previous  treatments.  
 
2  
DIAGNOSE  Name  the  problem.  Explain  why  it  happened.  Show  testimonial  proof  (Sunita  maam).  Present  the  inside-out  solution  path.  
 
3  
TREATMENT  PROCESS  Internal  (diet  +  dietitian)  +  External  (customised  serum,  doctor-led).  5-7  visits,  not  14  —  multiple  sessions  per  visit.  Schedule:  today  →  1  week  →  15-20  days.  
 
4  
DISCUSS  PACKAGE  The  math.  Lead  with  the  breakdown.  Total  ₹2,48,000.  50%  off  →  ₹1,24,000.  Products  ₹15,000  (calculate  in  front  of  her).  Diet  plan  ₹15,000.  Total  ₹1,54,000.  One-shot  offer  ₹1,39,000.  
 
5  
HANDLE  OBJECTIONS  Seven  specific  objections.  Each  has  its  own  script.  Never  invent  —  use  the  line.  
 
6  
CLOSE  +  ASSURANCE  +  FOLLOW-UP  Lock  payment  mode.  Process  the  deal.  Set  the  assurance  message.  Schedule  first  visit.  Log  follow-up  in  CRM  with  date  and  amount.
